name: Link
description: A link takes people to another page or place. Inline links sit in running text and are always underlined; standalone links stand on their own, like “View all orders”. External links open in a new tab and say so.
whenToUse: To go to another page, section or site.
For a secondary, low-emphasis navigation like “View all”.

whenNotToUse.text: To do something (save, delete, open a dialog).
For a prominent call to action that navigates.

anatomy.name: Underline
anatomy.description: Always on for inline links; on hover for standalone.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: Standalone links; external links get the external icon.

values.meaning: Inside a sentence; takes the surrounding text size. Default.
On its own line or next to content; has sizes and an icon.
Neutral color for footers, metadata and dense UI.

behavior.text: external opens a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer", shows an icon and adds “(opens in a new tab)” for screen readers.
Pass your router’s link component as `as`; it receives href and className.
Icons like arrows flip to point the reading direction.

content: Say where the link goes: “Read the return policy”, not “Click here”.
Keep link text unique on a page when the destinations differ.
Open new tabs only for other sites, and say so (external does).

guidelines.do: Use Link to go somewhere and Button to do something.
guidelines.dont: Use a link with onClick to submit or delete.
guidelines.why: Screen readers announce links and buttons differently; people expect them to behave differently.
Screen reader users often browse a list of links out of context.

guidelines.dont: Remove the underline from links in text.
guidelines.why: Color alone doesn’t identify a link for everyone (WCAG 1.4.1).

aria.when: “(opens in a new tab)” on external links.

examples.title: Inline
examples.code:
import { Link } from '@ds/react';

Read our return policy before you send an item back.

examples.title: Standalone with an icon
Router and external
examples.description: Use your router’s link, or open another site in a new tab.

components.name: Link
components.description: A link to another page or place. Links go somewhere; for actions, use a Button.

appearance.description:
`inline` (default) sits in running text, underlined and in the text's size; `standalone`
stands on its own, e.g. “View all orders”, and can have an icon and a size.

variant.description: `primary` (default) in the brand color; `secondary` neutral, for footers and dense UI.

icon.description: Icon after the text of a standalone link, e.g. an arrow. Hidden from screen readers.

external.description:
Opens in a new tab with an external-link icon and “(opens in a new tab)” for screen
readers. Use for other sites only.

externalLabel.description: Text announced for external links, for translation.

as.description: Render another element, e.g. your router's Link. It receives href and className.
